decision_conditions: Condition : 1 - 1.	The proposed extensions due to their disproportionate mass and scale would dominate and detract from the character and architectural interest of this Grade II Listed Building, contrary to adopted Unitary Development Plan policies ENV.B.1.1 (New Development) and ENV.B.2.7 (Alterations to Listed Buildings and Buildings of Local Townscape Character).

Condition : 2 - 2.	The size and position of the proposed extensions close to the boundaries of the site would harm neighbours' living conditions by way of bulk, dominance, over bearing effects and loss of privacy and outlook contrary to adopted Unitary Development Plan policies ENV.B.1.1 (New Development) and H.6.4 (Extensions and Alterations).

Condition : 3 - 3.	The proposal would provide inadequate levels of on-site parking in an area of high parking demand which would be likely to lead to conditions harmful to the free flow and safety of traffic and pedestrians in the vicinity, contrary to T.1.4 (Car and cycle parking and servicing facilities for developments) of the adopted Unitary Development Plan.

Condition : 4 - 4.	The proposal would fail to provide adequate access for people with disabilities contrary to the Council's adopted 'Think Access' guidelines and Unitary Development Plan policy ENV-B.1.1 (New Development) and the London Plan Supplementary Guidance 'Accessible London' document and London Plan policy 3A.4 Housing Choice.

Condition : 5 - 5.	Through provision of inadequate internal spaces (room sizes) and private amenity space (garden area) the proposal would result in cramped and unsatisfactory living conditions for future residents, contrary to adopted Unitary Development Plan policies ENV-B.1.1 (New Development) and H.4.1 (Housing Standards and Guidelines),
description: Partial demolition of listed building, erection of two storey extensions and conversion to 8 X 1 and 2 bed flats with associated landscaping and amenity area.
